item.description: Thank you. I may be able to find my (academic) way using some of your maps. I will try before I ask for help navigating, but I imagine if I can be a conduit between these cartographies and the Sacred Sites Summit it will be better (even if i get composted in the process). I don't think I can process and fortify fast enough or that I will even necessarily have the opportunity to engage at that level...which is likely appropriate and has its own wisdom. Tbc.
item.content:encoded:
Thank you. I may be able to find my (academic) way using some of your maps. I will try before I ask for help navigating, but I imagine if I can be a conduit between these cartographies and the Sacred Sites Summit it will be better (even if i get composted in the process). I don’t think I can process and fortify fast enough or that I will even necessarily have the opportunity to engage at that level…which is likely appropriate and has its own wisdom. Tbc.
